title: Local browser bridge and MCP command routing

checkpoint.summary: Implemented generic Jarvis browser bridge and Chromium extension in commit 962f8ec. Manual tab registration/aliases, paired loopback WebSocket, bounded execution of normal project .js files, MCP commands, config and permission policies, lifecycle and privacy protections.
checkpoint.nextAction: Independent review and real Chrome/Chromium 138+ end-to-end smoke test of extension loading, permissions, background tab execution, navigation/discard behavior and MCP routing. Do not merge or deploy before acceptance.
verified: dotnet test Jarvis.slnx --no-restore: 60 server and 271 client tests passed
